skill.name: swarm-planner
skill.description: Creates dependency-aware implementation plans for parallel multi-agent execution, with research, documentation checks, clarification gates, review, and saved plan output.
skill.summary: Plan coding work as dependency-aware tasks for parallel agent execution.
skill.author: am-will

content.value_statement: Large coding changes are hard to split across several agents without dependency mistakes. This skill creates dependency-aware implementation plans with research, clarification, review, and parallel execution groups.
actual_capabilities: Investigates architecture, existing patterns, dependencies, and frameworks before planning.
Asks clarification questions when scope, architecture, constraints, or priorities are unclear.
Retrieves current documentation for external libraries through Context7, MCP, or web search.
Creates tasks with explicit IDs, dependencies, locations, validation steps, status fields, and logs.
Groups ready tasks into parallel execution waves and saves the plan as Markdown.
Uses a subagent review step to check dependency gaps, ordering issues, and missing edge cases.
limitations: Does not implement tasks; it only creates the implementation plan.
Requires access to the target codebase and relevant documentation sources.
Plan quality depends on accurate user scope and available project context.
May need manual adjustment for teams that do not use parallel agents.

use_cases.title: Split a Feature Build
use_cases.description: Create a task graph for a new feature so independent database, service, UI, and test work can start in parallel.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Refactor
use_cases.description: Map a refactor into ordered tasks with clear validation so agents do not edit dependent layers too early.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Agent Execution
use_cases.description: Produce execution waves that show which tasks can run now and which tasks must wait for earlier results.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Small Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused code update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use swarm-planner to create a dependency-aware plan for adding [feature] to this repository. Ask clarification questions if the scope is unclear, then save the plan as [topic]-plan.md.

prompt_templates.title: Plan With Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use swarm-planner to plan [project change]. Check current documentation for any external libraries before finalizing tasks. Include dependencies, validation steps, and parallel execution groups.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a multi-layer codebase change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use swarm-planner to create a plan for refactoring [area]. Investigate existing architecture first, identify task dependencies, and include a testing strategy and risk mitigations.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Agent Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Use swarm-planner to produce a swarm-ready implementation plan for [initiative]. Optimize for parallel execution, include execution waves, and run the subagent review step before presenting the final plan.

output_examples.input: Plan adding password reset to an existing web application.
output_examples.output: A Markdown plan with research notes, prerequisite documentation checks, schema and email tasks, service and route tasks, UI tasks, tests, and parallel execution waves.

output_examples.input: Plan a repository-wide migration from one logging library to another.
output_examples.output: A dependency-aware task list that separates package updates, adapter creation, call-site migration, test updates, and verification into ordered waves.

output_examples.input: Plan a checkout performance improvement project for multiple agents.
output_examples.output: A reviewed plan that identifies independent profiling, query, cache, UI, and test tasks, with clear blockers and validation for each wave.

best_practices: Provide the target feature, repository area, constraints, and success criteria before invoking the skill.
Answer clarification questions before the plan is finalized, especially when scope or priority is uncertain.
Review the saved plan before assigning agents, then track status and logs as work progresses.
anti_patterns: Using the skill when you want immediate implementation instead of a plan.
Skipping documentation checks for external APIs that may have changed.
Assigning dependent tasks to agents before their required prerequisite tasks are complete.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It creates an implementation plan and explicitly instructs the agent not to implement the tasks.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before multi-step coding work, refactors, migrations, or any project that benefits from parallel agent execution.

faq.question: Why does it ask questions?
faq.answer: It asks questions when scope, constraints, priorities, or architecture are unclear enough to affect the plan.

faq.question: Does it require Context7?
faq.answer: It prefers Context7 or MCP for current documentation, but it can use web search if those tools are unavailable.

faq.question: What does the saved plan include?
faq.answer: The plan includes an overview, prerequisites, dependency graph, task details, parallel execution groups, tests, and risks.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
